Not a great picture, honestly, and I don't want to flatten it into one.

Priya's the real signal here — she said the backlog is genuinely stressful *and* that she doesn't feel heard when she raises it. That's two separate problems: the backlog itself, and whoever's supposed to be listening isn't landing for her. That shouldn't get smoothed into "some backlog concerns" — it's a person telling you she's raised something and gotten nowhere.

Riley says he's fine — I'll take that at face value, no reason to read anything into it.

Marcus didn't say much. I'm not going to guess why — could be nothing, could be something. Worth someone just asking him directly rather than me speculating.

So: one real, named pain point that hasn't been addressed, one person genuinely fine, one unknown. That's the actual state, not "good retro, minor notes."
